notes: Modified cash basis audit (village), FYE 9/30/2022. Governmental: General, Street, Debt Service (Totals column p5). Fund balances 426,796 -> 470,571 (p5) roll forward; cash (cash and cash equivalents + cash held by county treasurer) from the governmental funds statement p4: 2022 Total 409,955, 2021 comparative Total 403,650 (cash differs from fund balance by due from/to other funds). Taxes 233,650 split by printed breakdown: General Fund combining schedule p9 (property 62,106, motor vehicle 10,829, sales 32,667, franchise 54,439 incl. Fire 975), Statement of Activities p3 (property taxes for debt service 47,704) and the Street Fund remainder 25,905 = SoA franchise fees 80,344 - 54,439. Transfers: p5 'Transfers out' Total (5,633) = General (61,898) + Debt Service 56,265, matching the Ambulance fund's operating transfers in 5,633 (p7). Intergovernmental 204,054 kept as one line (only the General Fund part is broken down on p9: federal grants 39,822, municipal equalization 47,004, other 14,798, rural fire contribution 13,150). Capital outlay 69,698 mixes General 16,442, Fire 4,856, Park 7,650 and Street 40,750. Business-type from the modified cash proprietary statement p7 (Totals column); disbursement total = Statement of Activities business-type expenditures 336,916 (p2) = operating 235,716 + nonoperating 101,200; measure = cash as in FY2023-FY2024 (modified cash net position equals cash 230,464 less due to other funds 60,616). Capital expenses and debt service printed as nonoperating expenses are recorded as positive disbursements. Balance sheet = government-wide Statement of Net Position (p1), because it has internal balances; liabilities printed '-0-'. Detail: General Fund combining schedule p9 by department column; Street and Debt Service from the p5 fund columns; Sewer, Ambulance, Water, Sanitation from the p7 columns. The p8 combined budget-and-actual schedule (single all-funds column, includes Nursing Home lines not in the statements) was not recorded to avoid double counting; see decision_needed.
